title: Bad pick up spot
text: Pick up at Hard Rock is a bad choice. No ground level signs to indicate Hsrd Rock.
author: FPWhitePlains

title: Great small group tour inside the Basilica
text: 9 people were with our guide who was JC the owner of the tour company. Another 6 people were with a second guide. It was well worth it for the flawless skip the line process and JC who had been doing this 11 years had pictures in a folder and a great deliver Of all the facts we needed to know. He was really engaging with excellent English and the headpieces to listen to him worked well. His colleague Jennifer picked us up at our downtown hotel and JC called first to tell us where to wait and what she would be driving. She did a great job. Some people met us across from Sagrada Familia at the J
author: Lisa_M

title: We received an absolutely...
text: We received an absolutely outstanding Sagrada Família tour from Jorge.  His English was great, the listening devices worked extremely well, and his knowledge was fantastic.  Viator arranged to pick us up at the Barcelona port and communication was seamless using WhatsApp. Our party of six would highly recommend this tour and Jorge. We will fondly remember this excursion and would love to spend more time in Barcelona.
author: Lisa_C

title: Absolutely amazing and...
text: Absolutely amazing and wonderful tour. Our guide was very knowledgeable and personable. A must see in Barcelona
author: Zdenka_R

title: Octavio best tournament
text: Octavio was amazing! He was such a great guide and made our visit to the Sagrada Família so special. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and made sure we had a wonderful experience. Highly recommend Octavio! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
author: henriettb2021

title: Great Tour
text: We were picked up from our hotel.  That was well worth it.  The small group contained 6 people including us.  Perfect size.  Jose gave us a great tour with lots of good information.  He was easy to understand.  He gave us listening earbuds which worked great.  He allowed for questions too.  We were excited about going inside, and the guide went above our expectations during the entire tour..great tour
author: Elaine_P

title: Love it!
text: Jorge was a great licensed tour guide. He was very knowledgeable and friendly and just a great person all around!
author: lyhelmerich

title: No better way to see Sagarada Família than with Jorge
text: The small group tour of Sagrada Familia with Jorge was absolutely fabulous !!!  We learned so much from Jorge and he was a very knowledgeable guide with great English!!!  He took the time to show us the best photo spots and took pictures for us. I can’t say enough good things. Jorge was the best!!!  The tour was fabulous and very very very worth the cost!!!!
author: Deborah_P

title: Sagrada Família
text: Jorge was very knowledgeable and friendly.  The length was perfect.  Relieved we didn’t have to wait in the long lines.  Overall it was a great experience.  The fee was worth it.
author: 292lisao

title: Our tour guude was...
text: Our tour guude was excellent with a lot of knowledge and passion. On the other hand Viator's web site is very misleading - they said on their site. Meet and drop off same point. Then when we arrived they denied it. Very misleading and Viator rep not very customer oriented. Viator gets 1/2 *
